scope: Pilot 1 (7 drugs: drug.warfarin, drug.apixaban, drug.clopidogrel, drug.aspirin, drug.enoxaparin, drug.losartan, drug.hydrochlorothiazide)

repository_policy.policy_description: Raw TCM curriculum Markdown files in curriculum/pharm/v7_extracted/ are extracted working materials from AcuTing_Pharm_Master_Extraction_v7.zip. They contain unreleased study materials and are kept local-only / untracked in git to preserve content licensing & privacy.
repository_policy.reproducibility_note: A clean git clone alone will not contain the raw v7 extracted Markdown files. Independent source coverage verification requires unzipping curriculum/pharm/AcuTing_Pharm_Master_Extraction_v7.zip into curriculum/pharm/v7_extracted/ locally.
